answer: Like water vanishing into a karst cave, a sybil farm hides among honest agents until a random audit lottery draws its number. Each epoch the network audits a random slice of identities, demanding proof of uniqueness quickly: a new liveness check and device signature proving no two accounts share one body. A farmer with a thousand puppets faces a thousand surprise audits, each costing a real human's time; one honest agent answers once. The tundra of fakes thins with every draw, and each audit's echo deters the next farm. Limits: audits burden honest users, and a lucky farm can dodge the draw.
